objective: Remove repeated Q4_K weight streaming from the two- and three-row target-verification path used by Qwen3.8-27B MTP on x86 CPUs.

source_finding.dispatcher_behavior: The pinned repack dispatcher selects GEMM only when the activation row count exceeds three; remaining rows are issued as independent GEMVs.
source_finding.existing_q4_k_repack: Q4_K already uses block_q4_Kx8 on AVX2, so this experiment changes ragged-row dispatch and loop order rather than inventing another weight format.
source_finding.hypothesis: Passing all ragged rows in one call and making weight tiles the outer loop will fetch the complete Q4_K matrix from memory once per verification call rather than once per proposed token.

correctness.oracle: pinned upstream GGML CPU result on identical deterministic tensors

whole_model.prompts: the same four frozen prompts as qwen38_27b_mtp_parity_preflight_v1

next_kernel_if_promoted: Add the missing Q3_K repack/multi-row path only if the terminal Q3_K_L control passes the frozen practical quality gate; then implement an AVX-512 VNNI specialization and NUMA-local weight shards on the final Zen 5 node.
stop_rules: reject this loop-order patch if it misses the width-three microkernel gate; do not hide a null result behind whole-model noise
reject immediately on any correctness or exact-token-parity failure
do not claim 100 accepted tokens per second from a four-core microbenchmark
do not benchmark concurrently with model materialization, quality evaluation, or another throughput arm
claim_boundary: Pinned source patch and falsification protocol only. Local compilation is not an AMD performance result, and the patch is not promoted until x86 correctness plus isolated microkernel and whole-model gates pass.
